sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible in principle with four-year bachelor's-level preparation; finishing mathematics BA/BS applicants
accepted. Full-time only; concurrent degree enrollment prohibited. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select Mathematical Sciences doctoral program in shared application; obtain English exam even with UChicago
degree if nonnative speaker. [s1]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No mandatory pre-application supervisor agreement found. Eur is closest algebraic-geometry match; Anderson
number theory/arithmetic statistics. Broader department focuses differ from a large traditional AG group. [s5]
[s6] [s7]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Public application gateway offers login/create account, without public detailed referee workflow. [s8]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Current handbook is 2026-27, but admission deadline lacks explicit 2027-entry label and English page retains
2024 score wording. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Standing rule]
December 20 annual full-consideration cutoff; explicit 2027-entry year/timezone not verified. Later applications
may be unreviewed. [s1] [s2]
Funding consideration [Unresolved]

Reference receipt [Standing rule]

Test-score receipt [Conflict]

opening wording also says official scores for consideration. Clarify this inconsistency. [s1]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
All materials December 20 standing target. Unofficial transcripts accepted for review; official records if
admitted. [s1]

admissions.

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Conflict]
Nonnative speakers must test. Minimum/recommended: DET110/120, TOEFL86/100 on old120 scale,
IELTS6.5/7.5. Page still says exams 2024+; current expiration/new TOEFL-scale rules need confirmation. [s1]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Explicitly no US-degree exception for nonnative speakers. UChicago does not waive this department
requirement. [s1]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Scores not collected. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Recommended, optional; full consideration without. Self-report allowed for review, official result if admitted.
[s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
2026-27 handbook: USD3,000 monthly for nine academic months, USD27,000 total (arithmetic). Full tuition
remission; department financial-aid page covers transportation/activity/technology fees and individual health
insurance. Summer is additional, usually available, not guaranteed. [s2] [s3]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Satisfactory progress/teaching normally support five years; sixth year case-by-case. [s2]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International students participate in doctoral program; departmental funding policy has no published
citizenship exclusion. Rales is restricted to US citizens/permanent residents/DACA, hence F1 alone ineligible.
[s2] [s4]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
TA workload15-20 hours/week; no extra employment without authorization. Nonnative-speaker ITA test
Pass/Restricted I required by end of year2; missing certification can suspend funding. [s2]
Extra funding application [Unresolved]
Admission-specific extra departmental funding form not established. Later ABD fellowship requested first
month of preceding semester. [s2]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
External fellowship plus partial assistantship may be combined; departmental summer work/fellowships; one
semester ABD fellowship for eligible students. [s2] [s3]

Application fee [Standing rule]
No application fee. [s1]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Not needed: application free. [s1]
